title: taraxacum wibergense
intro: Taraxacum wibergense, commonly known as Wiberg's dandelion, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include digestive aid, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum wibergense include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
